data.name: Subtitle
data.value: Local interview companion - nothing leaves your PC

data.name: SetupRuntimeMissing
data.value: The local Whisper runtime is missing. Run scripts\build-whisper.ps1 (requires Git, CMake and a MinGW-w64 x64 toolchain), then restart the app.

data.name: SetupRuntimeMismatch
data.value: The Whisper runtime version {0} does not match the pinned build. Rebuild it with scripts\build-whisper.ps1 and restart.

data.name: SetupModelMissing
data.value: The speech model has not been downloaded yet. Use the Download button in Advanced settings.

data.name: SetupOllamaOffline
data.value: Ollama is not running (optional). Start it to enable AI answers and AI translation.

data.name: SetupOllamaModelMissing
data.value: Ollama is running, but model {0} is not pulled. Run: ollama pull {0}

data.name: StatusDeviceChanged
data.value: Output device changed - capture re-opened on the new device

data.name: CapturingNotice
data.value: System audio is being captured (loopback of the selected output device). The microphone is NOT used.

data.name: WhisperCliPathTip
data.value: Path to whisper-cli (or main). Leave empty to use the built-in native library adapter.

data.name: ModelPathTip
data.value: Explicit path to a ggml model file. Leave empty to use the app's model folder.

data.name: ModelSuggested
data.value: Suggested local models for this machine: Ollama: {0} | Whisper: {1}

data.name: EnableTranslation
data.value: Enable translation (off = show original, clearly labeled)

data.name: ExternalCliPathTip
data.value: e.g. C:\tools\mariannet.exe - text goes via stdin; first stdout line is the translation.

data.name: EngineHint
data.value: Engine settings apply after Stop. whisper (to English) reuses the speech model; External CLI needs a user-installed binary and models (never downloaded by the app).

data.name: OllamaModelTip
data.value: Model name pulled with: ollama pull <name>. Never downloaded by the app.

data.name: ContextBothLoaded
data.value: CV and job description loaded (kept local only).

data.name: PrivacyNote
data.value: Only the selected output device is captured (system audio, loopback) - the microphone is never used. Audio and transcripts are not recorded or stored.

data.name: DisclosureNote
data.value: Reminder: follow your interview's rules - disclose the use of assistance where required.

data.name: ErrorStopBeforeSettings
data.value: Stop listening before changing the speech engine or translation settings.

data.name: ErrorCouldNotApplySpeech
data.value: Could not apply the speech settings: {0}

data.name: ErrorCouldNotEnumerateDevices
data.value: Could not enumerate audio devices. Check that an audio output is connected, then try again.

data.name: ErrorNoOutputDevice
data.value: No active audio output device found. Connect speakers/headphones and press Refresh.

data.name: ErrorModelDownload
data.value: The model download failed (network issue or wrong model name). Check the connection and the model name, then try again.

data.name: AiUnavailable
data.value: Local AI (Ollama): not running - answer suggestions disabled (transcription still works)

data.name: AiModelMissing
data.value: Local AI (Ollama): running, model '{0}' MISSING - run: ollama pull {0}

data.name: SpeechModelMissing
data.value: MISSING - download it or set the model path

data.name: ErrorCaptureStart
data.value: Could not start capturing system audio. Check the selected output device, press Refresh, and try again.

data.name: ErrorDeviceLost
data.value: The audio output device was disconnected. Capture stopped.

data.name: ErrorDeviceReopen
data.value: The default audio device changed, but capture could not be re-opened.

data.name: ErrorWhisperExeMissing
data.value: The whisper.cpp executable is missing. Set a valid path in Advanced settings.

data.name: ErrorWhisperModelMissing
data.value: The speech model file is missing. Press Download (an explicit action) or set a valid model path.

data.name: ErrorNativeLibMissing
data.value: The local whisper runtime (whisper.cpp) is missing. Rebuild the distribution package with the native runtime (scripts\build-whisper.ps1) or run that script and restart the app.

data.name: ErrorWhisperVersionMismatch
data.value: The whisper runtime version is not compatible with this app (it was built for the pinned version). Rebuild the runtime with scripts\build-whisper.ps1.

data.name: ErrorModelPrepare
data.value: The local speech models could not be prepared. Check the speech settings in Advanced.

data.name: ErrorUnknownModel
data.value: The configured speech model is not recognized. Choose tiny, base, small or medium.

data.name: ErrorWhisperRun
data.value: whisper.cpp failed while transcribing. Check the executable and model in Advanced settings.

data.name: ErrorWhisperTimeout
data.value: The transcription took too long and was stopped.

data.name: ErrorOllama
data.value: The local AI assistant (Ollama) reported an error. Check that it is running with the configured model.

data.name: ErrorRuntime
data.value: Something went wrong while processing the audio.

data.name: TranslStatusPassThrough
data.value: Translation is disabled — the original text is shown.

data.name: TranslStatusEcho
data.value: The engine returned the text unchanged (it is not a translation).

data.name: TranslStatusProviderUnavailable

data.name: TranslStatusProviderFailed
data.value: Translation failed — the original text is shown.

data.name: TranslStatusNoOutput
data.value: No translation was produced — the original text is shown.

data.name: TranslStatusNeedsSource
data.value: This engine needs a pinned source language — set the interview language to enable translation.

data.name: TranslStatusPairNotSupported

data.value: The translation CLI could not be launched — check the executable path in Advanced settings.

data.name: TranslStatusCliTimeout
data.value: The translation timed out — the original text is shown.

data.name: TranslStatusCliError
data.value: The translation CLI reported an error — the original text is shown.

data.name: TranslStatusWhisperEnglishOnly
data.value: whisper translation supports English only — use Ollama for the target language {0}.

data.value: The active speech engine does not support whisper translate mode — set the whisper CLI path or use Ollama.

data.name: DocInUse
data.value: In use for answer grounding ({0} chars)

data.name: DocPrivacy
data.value: Kept in memory only for this session — never written to disk or logs.

data.name: ErrorDocUnsupported
data.value: Unsupported file type. Import a PDF, DOCX, or TXT file.

data.name: ErrorDocCorrupt
data.value: The file could not be read (corrupt or invalid format).

data.name: ErrorDocOversized
data.value: The file is too large (max {0} MB).

data.name: ErrorDocNoText
data.value: No text could be extracted (scanned/image PDF? Use a text-based file instead).

data.name: ErrorDocEmptyUse
data.value: The text is empty — import or paste content first.

data.name: ErrorDocTruncated
data.value: Only the first {0} characters were imported.

data.name: AnswerStatusUnavailable
data.value: The local AI (Ollama) isn't running, so there's no answer suggestion right now. Start Ollama and try again — transcription and translation keep working.

data.name: AnswerStatusModelMissing
data.value: The Ollama model '{0}' isn't installed on this machine. Run `ollama pull {0}` (or pick another model in settings), then try again.

data.name: AnswerStatusFailed
data.value: Answer generation failed (local Ollama error). Transcription and translation keep working — try the question again.

data.name: AnswerStatusTimeout
data.value: Answer generation timed out. The local model is still busy or too large for this machine — try again, or pick a smaller model.

data.name: AnswerStatusEmpty
data.value: The model returned an empty answer. Try again, or choose a different model.

data.name: AnswerDisclaimer
data.value: Suggestion for review — check it against your own experience before using it in your interview.
